rules.statement: A decision of a District Judge confirming a final scheme of partition is not an order as envisaged by Section 36A of the Partition Law, if it finally disposes of the matter in dispute.
rules.supporting_quote: In other words, if the District Judge concluded the other way, granting that the alternative scheme of partition was correct instead of granting that the final scheme of partition was correct, then again the matter comes to a finality.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 36A of the Partition Law as amended by Act No. 17 of 1997
